**Proposal: “Mirror” path swap based on our colors.**  
- I want you to cover the 5 blue tiles on the path:  
  (0,1), (0,2), (0,3), (1,3), (2,3)  
- I will cover the 5 red tiles for you on your path:  
  (1,0), (1,1), (2,1), (2,2), (3,2)

- (1,3): You give me a B  
- (2,3): You give me a B
